title.zh: 什么是人工智能？定义与历史
title.en: What is Artificial Intelligence? Definition and History

summary.zh: 本课程面向人工智能初学者，在AI与伦理导论场景中系统介绍AI的基本定义、发展历史和技术分层体系，帮助学习者厘清概念边界并建立完整认知框架。课程通过图灵测试案例、历史时间线分析和CIFAR-10数据集对比实验，结合对话轮数、准确率等关键指标，展示从理论基础到技术实践的完整路径。
summary.en: This course targets AI beginners within the Introduction to AI & Ethics context, systematically presenting basic definitions, development history, and technical stratification of artificial intelligence to help learners clarify conceptual boundaries and establish a comprehensive cognitive framework. Through Turing Test cases, historical timeline analysis, and CIFAR-10 dataset comparison experiments with key metrics like conversation rounds and accuracy rates, the course demonstrates the complete pathway from theoretical foundations to technical practice.

content.zh:
本课程从人工智能的基础定义出发，追溯其历史发展脉络，帮助学习者建立对AI技术体系的整体认知。通过理解AI、机器学习与深度学习的层次关系，您将能够更清晰地定位不同技术在实际应用中的角色与边界。

人工智能的基本概念与定义

人工智能作为计算机科学的重要分支，致力于开发能够执行通常需要人类智能任务的系统。学习者常将AI等同于科幻作品中的机器人，或混淆其与机器学习、深度学习的边界。

核心定义包括：

  • 人工智能（AI）：使机器模拟人类智能行为的科学与工程
  • 图灵测试（Turing Test）：通过对话判断机器是否具备人类智能水平的经典方法（来源：Turing test，2023）
  • 机器学习（Machine Learning）：通过算法从数据中学习模式而非显式编程
  • 深度学习（Deep Learning）：基于多层神经网络的学习方法

神经网络作为深度学习的基础，由输入层、隐藏层和输出层构成，每个神经元通过权重连接，通过激活函数处理输入信号。这种结构模拟了生物神经元的信号传递机制，为复杂模式识别提供了理论基础。

以图灵测试为例，其实现逻辑可通过伪代码展示：

function turingTest(judge, machine, human) {
  let machineMistaken = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < totalTests; i++) {
    let response = judge.interact(randomSelect([machine, human]));
    if (judge.isMistaken(response)) machineMistaken++;
  }
  return machineMistaken / totalTests > 0.3;
}

该测试通过对话轮数、误判率等指标评估机器智能水平，体现了早期AI研究的理论基础。理解这些基本概念为后续探索技术发展历程奠定基础。

人工智能的历史演进与关键里程碑

AI发展并非线性进步，而是经历了多次繁荣与寒冬的交替。从达特茅斯会议确立学科到深度学习革命，每个阶段都反映了技术范式的转变。

重要历史节点包括：

  • 1950年：图灵提出机器智能测试标准
  • 1956年：达特茅斯会议正式确立AI学科（来源：A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence，1956）
  • 1980年代：专家系统兴起与应用
  • 2012年：深度学习在ImageNet挑战赛取得突破

AI寒冬主要成因包括计算资源限制、算法瓶颈和预期落差。1974-1980年第一次寒冬源于早期神经网络训练困难，1987-1993年第二次寒冬因专家系统维护成本过高。符号主义基于逻辑推理，连接主义依赖神经网络学习，两者在历史中交替主导。

通过时间线分析可以清晰展现技术发展脉络：

const milestones = [
  { year: 1950, event: "图灵测试", type: "理论" },
  { year: 1956, event: "达特茅斯会议", type: "范式" },
  { year: 1997, event: "深蓝击败卡斯帕罗夫", type: "应用" }
];
function plotTimeline(milestones) {
  return milestones.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
}

这种历史视角有助于理解当前AI技术的来源与局限，为认识现代技术分层提供背景支撑。

现代人工智能的技术分层与关系辨析

明确AI、机器学习与深度学习的层次关系是理解现代人工智能体系的关键。这种包含关系体现了从规则驱动到数据驱动的范式演进。

技术层级解析：

  • 人工智能（AI）⊃ 机器学习（Machine Learning）⊃ 深度学习（Deep Learning）
  • 机器学习专注于从数据中自动发现模式
  • 深度学习通过多层神经网络学习数据的层次化特征

以CIFAR-10图像分类任务为例，使用不同技术层级的实现差异明显：

# 使用CIFAR-10数据集的性能对比
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from tensorflow import keras

# 传统机器学习方法
svm = SVC().fit(X_train, y_train)
acc_svm = svm.score(X_test, y_test)  # 准确率约60%

# 深度学习方法
model = keras.Sequential([...])
model.compile(...)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
acc_cnn = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test)  # 准确率可达85%以上

数据集包含60000张32x32彩色图像，分为10个类别。训练步骤包括数据预处理、模型构建、训练优化和性能评估。中间结果显示传统方法在特征提取上存在局限，而深度学习能自动学习层次特征。

2012年AlexNet在ImageNet挑战赛中的突破性表现（来源：ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge，2014）充分展示了深度学习在复杂模式识别中的优势。这种技术分层理解有助于在实际应用中正确选择合适的方法。

通过对人工智能定义、历史演进和技术分层的系统学习，您已建立起对AI技术体系的基础认知。这种理解将帮助您在后续学习中更清晰地把握不同技术方法的适用场景与发展方向。
content.en:
This course begins with the fundamental definition of artificial intelligence, tracing its historical development to help learners build a comprehensive understanding of the AI technology ecosystem. By clarifying the hierarchical relationships between AI, machine learning, and deep learning, you'll be better equipped to identify the roles and boundaries of different technologies in practical applications.

Fundamental Concepts and Definitions of Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a crucial branch of computer science focused on developing systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence. Learners often mistakenly equate AI with robots from science fiction or confuse its boundaries with machine learning and deep learning.

Core definitions include:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI): The science and engineering of making machines simulate human intelligent behavior
  • Turing Test: A classical method to determine if a machine exhibits human-level intelligence through conversation (Source: Turing test, 2023)
  • Machine Learning: Learning patterns from data through algorithms rather than explicit programming
  • Deep Learning: A learning method based on multi-layer neural networks

Neural networks, as the foundation of deep learning, consist of input layers, hidden layers, and output layers, with each neuron connected through weights and processing input signals via activation functions. This structure simulates biological neuron signal transmission mechanisms, providing theoretical basis for complex pattern recognition.

The implementation logic of the Turing Test can be demonstrated through pseudocode:

function turingTest(judge, machine, human) {
  let machineMistaken = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < totalTests; i++) {
    let response = judge.interact(randomSelect([machine, human]));
    if (judge.isMistaken(response)) machineMistaken++;
  }
  return machineMistaken / totalTests > 0.3;
}

This test evaluates machine intelligence through metrics like conversation rounds and misjudgment rates, reflecting the theoretical foundation of early AI research. Understanding these basic concepts lays the groundwork for exploring technological development history.

Historical Evolution and Key Milestones of Artificial Intelligence

AI development has not followed a linear progression but has experienced multiple cycles of boom and winter. From the Dartmouth Conference establishing the discipline to the deep learning revolution, each phase reflects shifts in technological paradigms.

Significant historical milestones include:

  • 1950: Turing proposes standards for testing machine intelligence
  • 1956: Dartmouth Conference formally establishes AI as a discipline (Source: A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence, 1956)
  • 1980s: Rise and application of expert systems
  • 2012: Deep learning achieves breakthrough in ImageNet Challenge

Primary causes of AI winters include computational resource limitations, algorithmic bottlenecks, and expectation gaps. The first winter (1974-1980) stemmed from early neural network training difficulties, while the second (1987-1993) resulted from high maintenance costs of expert systems. Symbolic AI relies on logical reasoning, while connectionist AI depends on neural network learning, with both approaches alternating dominance throughout history.

Timeline analysis clearly reveals the trajectory of technological development:

const milestones = [
  { year: 1950, event: "Turing Test", type: "Theory" },
  { year: 1956, event: "Dartmouth Conference", type: "Paradigm" },
  { year: 1997, event: "Deep Blue defeats Kasparov", type: "Application" }
];
function plotTimeline(milestones) {
  return milestones.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
}

This historical perspective helps understand the origins and limitations of current AI technologies, providing context for comprehending modern technical stratification.

Technical Stratification and Relationship Analysis in Modern AI

Clarifying the hierarchical relationships between AI, machine learning, and deep learning is essential for understanding the modern artificial intelligence ecosystem. This containment relationship reflects the paradigm shift from rule-driven to data-driven approaches.

Technical hierarchy analysis:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) ⊃ Machine Learning ⊃ Deep Learning
  • Machine learning focuses on automatically discovering patterns from data
  • Deep learning learns hierarchical features of data through multi-layer neural networks

Taking CIFAR-10 image classification as an example, implementation differences across technical levels are evident:

# Performance comparison using CIFAR-10 dataset
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from tensorflow import keras

# Traditional machine learning approach
svm = SVC().fit(X_train, y_train)
acc_svm = svm.score(X_test, y_test)  # Accuracy around 60%

# Deep learning approach
model = keras.Sequential([...])
model.compile(...)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
acc_cnn = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test)  # Accuracy can exceed 85%

The dataset contains 60,000 32x32 color images across 10 categories. Training steps include data preprocessing, model construction, training optimization, and performance evaluation. Intermediate results show traditional methods have limitations in feature extraction, while deep learning automatically learns hierarchical features.

The breakthrough performance of AlexNet in the 2012 ImageNet Challenge (Source: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge, 2014) fully demonstrates deep learning's advantages in complex pattern recognition. This understanding of technical stratification helps in selecting appropriate methods for practical applications.

Through systematic learning of artificial intelligence definitions, historical evolution, and technical stratification, you have established a foundational understanding of the AI technology ecosystem. This comprehension will help you better grasp the applicable scenarios and development directions of different technical methods in subsequent learning.

explain.zh:
根据课程s1章节图灵测试标准，当机器被误判为人类的比例超过30%时即通过测试。计算：35/100=35%>30%，因此机器通过测试。选项1错误因为标准是30%而非40%；选项3虽然结论正确但理由不准确；选项4错误因为100次测试已足够统计显著性。

Option 1 is incorrect because the standard is 30% not 40%; Option 3 has the correct conclusion but inaccurate reasoning; Option 4 is wrong because 100 tests provide sufficient statistical significance.

question.zh:
【来自：s2 · 数据：AI历史时间线里程碑数据】根据AI历史时间线数据，计算1950年至2012年期间AI重大突破的平均间隔年数。
已知关键事件年份：1950(图灵测试), 1956(达特茅斯会议), 1997(深蓝), 2012(ImageNet突破)
question.en:
【Source: s2 · Data: AI历史时间线里程碑数据】Based on AI historical timeline data, calculate the average interval in years between major AI breakthroughs from 1950 to 2012.
Given key event years: 1950(Turing Test), 1956(Dartmouth Conference), 1997(Deep Blue), 2012(ImageNet breakthrough)

explain.zh:
计算步骤：
1. 计算相邻事件间隔：1956-1950=6年, 1997-1956=41年, 2012-1997=15年
2. 总间隔数：3个间隔
3. 总年数：6+41+15=62年
4. 平均间隔：62÷3≈20.67年
数据来源：s2章节历史时间线里程碑数据，反映AI发展的不连续性。
评分提示：正确计算所有间隔年数；准确求平均值；保留合适小数位数；引用s2时间线数据
explain.en:
Calculation steps:
1. Calculate adjacent event intervals: 1956-1950=6 years, 1997-1956=41 years, 2012-1997=15 years
2. Total intervals: 3 intervals
3. Total years: 6+41+15=62 years
4. Average interval: 62÷3≈20.67 years
Data source: historical timeline milestone data in section s2, reflecting the discontinuity of AI development.
Scoring note: 正确计算所有间隔年数；准确求平均值；保留合适小数位数；引用s2时间线数据

question.zh: 【来自：s1 · 数据：图灵测试指标定义与对话数据】假设图灵测试中评委与机器进行了50轮对话，其中8轮对话时间超过30秒，12轮对话轮数超过5轮。如果『响应时间超标率』定义为超时对话轮数占比，请计算该指标值。
question.en: 【Source: s1 · Data: 图灵测试指标定义与对话数据】Assuming in a Turing test, the judge conducted 50 conversation rounds with the machine, where 8 rounds exceeded 30 seconds response time, and 12 rounds had over 5 conversation turns. If 'response time exceedance rate' is defined as the proportion of timeout conversation rounds, calculate this metric value.

explain.zh:
计算过程：
响应时间超标率 = 超时对话轮数 / 总对话轮数 × 100%
= 8 / 50 × 100% = 16%
注意：对话轮数超过5轮的信息为干扰项，计算响应时间超标率只需关注超时轮数。该指标是s1章节中图灵测试评估指标之一，用于衡量机器响应效率。
评分提示：正确识别相关数据（8轮超时）；准确应用百分比公式；排除干扰信息；引用s1指标概念
explain.en:
Calculation process:
Response time exceedance rate = Timeout conversation rounds / Total conversation rounds × 100%
= 8 / 50 × 100% = 16%
Note: The information about over 5 conversation turns is a distractor; calculating response time exceedance rate only requires timeout rounds. This metric is one of the Turing test evaluation indicators in section s1, used to measure machine response efficiency.
Scoring note: 正确识别相关数据（8轮超时）；准确应用百分比公式；排除干扰信息；引用s1指标概念
